exposure: Use of video recordings of neonatal resuscitation events
outcome: Feasibility of video recording as an assessment tool
Quality of neonatal resuscitation care indicators (e.g., heat loss prevention, airway management, ventilation timing and effectiveness)
Acceptability of video recording among health workers and delivering women
cohort: Delivering women and their newborns, and the health workers involved in neonatal resuscitation, at Chake-Chake Hospital in Pemba, Tanzania.
finding: It was found feasible and acceptable to use video recordings to assess neonatal resuscitation quality of care in a low-resource setting, which revealed significant deviations from national guidelines in all eight observed resuscitation cases.
